headline: Man City 'deserved' trophies - PSG boss Luis Enrique on charges
description: Paris Saint-Germain boss Luis Enrique has said Manchester City deserve to keep the trophies won during the period in which they have been found guilty of breaching Premier League rules.

headline: Football Regulator chair will quit if politics interferes with any Man City investigation
description: The chair of the Independent Football Regulator (IFR) has said he will quit if there is political interference in any future investigation launched into Manchester City.

headline: Regulator: English football must address finances 'before it is too late'
description: The chair of the Independent Football Regulator says the English game must "act before it is too late" to tackle the financial dangers facing it.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona, Real Madrid scout Erling Haaland at Anfield
description: Barcelona and Real Madrid continue to keep tabs on Erling Haaland, while Chelsea growing confident of signing Bournemouth's Alex Scott. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Unai Emery keen for Aston Villa to use home advantage in Fenerbahce clash
description: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery wants his side to enjoy their home comforts once again when they host Fenerbahce in the Champions League.

headline: Liverpool's Alexander Isak, Cody Gakpo, Dominik Szoboszlai to miss Champions League clash with LASK
description: Liverpool are set to be without Alexander Isak, Cody Gakpo and Dominik Szoboszlai for Wednesday's UEFA Champions League clash with LASK.
